column1: # ZAP rule overrides for the attack lab (zap-baseline.py / zap-api-scan.py -c).
# Every IGNORE carries the reason it is safe to ignore, and what covers the
# risk instead. A rule is never ignored because it is noisy: noise is a reason
# to fix the finding or to downgrade it to INFO with a reason, not to hide it.
# CSP: Wildcard Directive. img-src allows https: because admins can paste
# externally hosted image URLs into a project. Documented in
# docs/SECURITY_AUDIT.md (CSP table). Kept visible as WARN, not ignored.

column3: (CSP: img-src https: and style-src unsafe-inline are deliberate - see SECURITY_AUDIT.md CSP table; framer-motion needs inline styles)

column1: # Private IP Disclosure. Fires on /api/admin/audit-log, whose clientIp column
# is the point of the endpoint (ADMIN only; the lab network is 10.x). Kept as
# WARN so a private address leaking from any other endpoint is still reported.

column3: (Private IP in the admin-only audit log is by design; anywhere else it is a finding)

column1: # HTTP Only Site. The lab proxy is plain HTTP on purpose; in production TLS ends
# at Render/Cloudflare and HSTS is sent (ForwardedProtoFilter, ForwardedHeadersBypassTest).

column3: (Lab is HTTP by design; production TLS is at the edge)

column1: # Unexpected Content-Type. Fires on /swagger-ui/index.html, which is HTML by
# design and exists only because the lab sets SWAGGER_ENABLED=true for the API
# scan. The API itself answers JSON everywhere, including the root.

column3: (Swagger UI is HTML and lab-only; any other endpoint returning HTML is a finding)
